comment: Generated by proto/go/zs TestCatalogAggregateVectors. Each node's catalog is its /v1/zs/details models as advertised; bare_models are listed with no capability entry. A node contributes only when advertisable at now_ms (registry_cycle_vectors.json pins that gate). models and builtin_tools (types) are in first-seen order; model_details is the cross-operator capability union, sorted by id.

cases.name: an empty fleet lists nothing
one node lists its own catalog as advertised
two operators merge: modalities and tags unioned, sizing and rates the lowest declared, flags ORed
a free cache read beats a discounted one, and an absent one is not free
image routes: any operator serving one makes the aggregate serve it, at the lowest non-zero rate
every rate and image factor takes the lower of two declared values, whichever node declared it
a value a node repeats in a modality or effort list is kept as it repeats
tags fold to one lowercase entry each, trimmed, blanks dropped, in code point order
coordinates take each field's majority, and a tie omits it
coordinates that disagree on every field are dropped
one published weights digest is the consensus; an operator publishing none breaks nothing
two distinct weights digests are a mismatch with no consensus
sources agree across revision and case, and the first spelling is kept; canonical_id rides only without a source
sources naming different repos have no consensus, and the canonical then rides
canonicals that disagree have no consensus
models and tools keep the order first seen across nodes, each tool type once
a model listed with no capability entry is listed bare
a staging node the payer has not opted in to contributes nothing
a staging node the payer opted in to contributes
a node on another wire major contributes nothing
a node whose signer is below the routing floor contributes nothing
a node probed down this cycle contributes nothing
an unprobed node inside the carry window contributes its carried catalog
an unprobed node exactly at the carry window's edge contributes nothing
